title: Checkout behavior and proposed adapter contract
audience: Maintainers implementing or reviewing the checkout gate
purpose: Keep observed behavior, existing documentary authority, and a future adapter proposal distinguishable.
scope: The prepared checkout function and an explicitly proposed adapter error code; no deployed server is asserted.
requirement_convention: Preserve the fixture's shall wording for specified requirements; observed statements describe implementation and proposals are not approved.

sections.title: Behavior
sections.content: The guest gate returns one of two dictionaries according to user presence and the guest_checkout setting.

sections.title: Interface boundary
sections.content: The examined callable is checkout(user, items). An HTTP adapter is outside the examined function and is not asserted here.

sections.title: Data contract
sections.content: On the successful branch the supplied items become the order value without item validation in this body.

sections.title: Denial behavior
sections.content: A falsey user with disabled guest checkout returns 401 and requires_login true. No exception translation is implemented in this body.

sections.title: Security boundary
sections.content: This body applies the guest gate but does not authenticate a user object or establish server authorization.

sections.title: Quality target scope
sections.content: The supplied contract expressly leaves performance targets unagreed; this document makes no latency, availability, or throughput guarantee.

sections.title: Verification intent
sections.content: The prepared test file contains assertions for denied and allowed guest checkout. These assertions have been inspected, not executed by Understand Code.

requirements.statement: When user is falsey and guest_checkout is false, checkout returns status 401 with requires_login true.
requirements.rationale: Describe the implementation branch without upgrading it into stakeholder intent.

verification.procedure: Inspect the conditional and the matching test assertion; no test execution is claimed.
verification.expected: Both sources express the denied-guest result.

requirements.statement: When guest checkout is disabled and no user is supplied, checkout shall return status 401 with requires_login true.
requirements.rationale: The prepared contract is documentary authority for this obligation.

verification.procedure: In an authorized fixture environment, disable guest checkout and call checkout with no user.
verification.expected: The result contains status 401 and requires_login true; this is a verification plan, not a recorded run.

requirements.statement: A future checkout adapter should expose the stable error code authentication_required when the guest gate denies access.
requirements.origin: Prepared change request in contract.md; pending maintainer decision and implementation.
requirements.rationale: Make the future adapter contract assessable without claiming that an adapter currently exists.

verification.procedure: After an adapter is implemented and its contract accepted, exercise its guest-denial path.
verification.expected: The future adapter exposes authentication_required; no existing test execution or approval is asserted.

review_when: the guest gate or return shape changes.
the adapter request is accepted, rejected, or implemented.
